source_document.title: 陳雨靚_專題 1013 光洋科財報不實事件與財務異常預警模型研究（14 頁研究簡報）
source_document.owner: 陳雨靚（研究方法負責人）
source_document.redistribution: not_redistributed; cited by slide page only

verification_rule: An event is shown as verified only when an archived official record (historical audit archive, re-read on every request) carries the claim. E2 = archived official bytes with the quote verified; E1 = official listing metadata only (date and title, not the content). Anything else stays needs_source_verification and is never used in a model calculation.
incident_distinction: The 2015 physical gold-transfer incident (an asset loss from employee misconduct) and the FY2011–FY2015 financial restatement (multi-year reporting misstatement) are different events with different loss measures. Slide 5 states that the ~NT$3.27 billion five-year net-income reduction must not be equated with the gold-transfer loss.

excluded_archive_records.reason: concerns another company (樂陞科技, 3662); not 1785 evidence

events.title: 員工不法轉出黃金（約 450 公斤，涉及存貨管理）

events.verification_scope: 封存資料只有 2016-04-08「本公司對員工不法行為提起刑事訴訟」的官方清單標題；數量、發生季度與 5.13 億元損失皆未經官方原文驗證。
